name: Hur
description: Aaron's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Moses stood on the top of the hill with the rod of God in his hand: when Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed; when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed. His hands were heavy, so they set a stone under him, and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side and the other on the other side, steady until the going down of the sun; and Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

note.label: Nolan Wells: The Perpetual Hatred We Never Learned

points: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed; when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed. Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands until the going down of the sun. Moses was about eighty years old holding a rod above his head all day; the fathers were mighty men, stronger than we are today.

note.label: Exodus 17: Water Out of the Rock and War With Amalek

points: The Lord called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, and filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship, to devise cunning works, to work in gold, in silver, in brass, in cutting of stones, and in carving of timber.

note.label: Exodus 31: Bezaleel and Aholiab, and the Sabbath Sign

points: The Lord called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, and filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship; the Most High put His spirit on him to be gifted in what he did, to devise curious works in gold, silver, and brass, in cutting of stones, and in carving of wood.

note.label: Exodus 35: The Sabbath and the Willing Hearted Offering

points: The sons of Judah and the families that came from them are set down, including the line of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
